featured_reviews.name: Dr. Akansha Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
The location is the selling point here
It’s in the middle of a myriad of shops
Where almost everything can be accessible
From local groceries to a beauty parlour
A ladies tailor and also a dry cleaner is just across the road

I guess the hostel can do better when it comes to serving better breakfast
In terms of both quality and quantity
But still it’s do-able

The dinner provided is a balanced meal and I thoroughly enjoy it after a laborious day’s work
Proteins, fibre and carbs all balanced

Feels like home 🏡 😁
The rooms in the new building are well spaced and organised well

5 common washrooms for like 20 girls is a good number
It’s maintained well in terms of hygiene and basic needs are tended to
Especially like the 24 hours hot water supply

Interestingly their terms of stay are malleable
And that also for a reasonable rate
I find it a steal especially when the food is included and the place gives a homely vibe

😇😁❤️
